sections.title: Sample projects for layout checks
sections.what: Imports the test runner, the slide builders and the synthesis module, then creates twelve sample projects with rising overruns.

sections.watch_out: The sample values decide how many labels collide, so changing them changes the test result.

sections.title: Overlap rule and the two tests
sections.what: Defines the rule that two rectangles overlap, then runs the label placement test and the synthesis retention test.
sections.why: Keeps the overlap rule in one place for both checks.
sections.watch_out: The rule counts edges that only touch as not overlapping, so near misses can pass.

summary: Two automated tests that check chart labels stay inside their boxes without overlapping bubbles, and that synthesis slides keep every full finding with its source.
purpose: Prevents cluttered charts and cut-off findings in generated presentation slides.
why: Likely reason: slides are built automatically, so these tests catch layout and text loss that a person would otherwise have to notice by eye.
how: For three sizing modes, builds a chart from twelve sample projects and checks that captions sit inside their quadrants and labels do not overlap bubbles. Then builds the synthesis slides and checks that every bullet appears in full with a source, an arrow is present, and two specific expected statements are included.
inputs: Twelve generated sample projects, the chart and slide builders, and the case synthesis module.
outputs: Pass or fail for each node test.
risks: Exact expected phrases such as 169 days break if wording changes. The overlap check uses simple rectangles, not exact shapes.
debug: If a label test fails, check label placement in the chart builder. If the synthesis test fails, check the bullet text and source fields in caseSynthesis.
